sloka: परस्परं घ्नतो स्तत्र वानरासुरयोस्तदा ।आसीदसुरो युद्धे शक्रसूनुर्व्यवर्धत ॥४-११-४४॥।।
transliteration: parasparaṁ ghnato statra vānarāsurayostadā ।āsīdasuro yuddhe śakrasūnurvyavardhata ॥4-11-44॥।।

translations.english: 'Then as the monkey and demon fought pouncing on each other, the prowess of Dundubhi got diminished and that of Vali, the son of Indra, increased.
